_note: Canonical source for every audience number Delaware Beach Finds publishes. A metric renders ONLY when it has BOTH a non-null value AND a verifiedAt date. Anything unverified stays null and is invisible on the site — there is no placeholder, no estimate, no 'coming soon'. Ground-truth the numbers, fill value + verifiedAt + period + source, run scripts/validate_editorial.py, deploy. No code or design change required.
_howToFill: For each metric: set value (number, or string for a range you can defend), period (what window the number covers), verifiedAt (YYYY-MM-DD, the day you read it off the platform), and source (where you read it). Leave note null unless a caveat matters to a buyer. Delete nothing — an unfilled metric is simply not displayed.
_rules: Never enter a number you have not personally read off the platform.
verifiedAt is the date you READ the number, not the end of the period.
A metric older than staleAfterDays stops rendering until re-verified.
Do not add a metric key for a channel that does not exist yet.
